claims.explanation: The area of the pasture should be x(200-2x) = 200x - 2x^2, not 200x - 2x^2 + 100. The extra '+100' is not part of the area formula.
Completing the square on the written area 200x - 2x^2 + 100 gives -2(x-50)^2 + 5100, not -2(x-50)^2 + 720. On the correct area 200x - 2x^2, it gives -2(x-50)^2 + 5000.
